SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-05: CQL - Type Operators - Structural. Test these items: As<T>(argument); Children(argument); Convert to<T>(argument); Descendants(argument); Is<T>(argument).

For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. This is the EXPLORER pass and must independently rerun the chunk against the current code left by SKEPTIC and HISTORIAN; do not inspect or rely on archived prior outputs.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Type Operators: is/as with List<T>; structural Children()/Descendants() return collections of child elements
issues.evidence: Children({ a: 1 }) is List<Any> and Children({ a: 1, b: {2}, n: null }) is List<Integer> failed or fell through to resource probing before structural list checks.
issues.root_cause: Translator had scalar structural child handling but no list-level type check for cqlChildren/cqlDescendants outputs.
issues.resolution: Added _cql_structural_list_type_check and routed structural list is/as checks before FHIR resource type probing.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py; full fhir4ds pytest 7148 passed; conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Type Operators: is/as are type assertions, not textual conversions
issues.evidence: First(Children({ a: @2024-01-01 })) and First(Children({ a: 1L })) needed Date/Long identity preservation across DuckDB VARCHAR[] traversal transport.
issues.root_cause: Structural traversal encoded temporal and Long primitive children as untyped strings/numbers.
issues.resolution: Tagged Date, DateTime, Time, and Long tuple traversal values and decoded tags in structural is/as.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py; full fhir4ds pytest 7148 passed; conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Clinical Types and Type Operators: Code and Concept are distinct clinical value types
issues.evidence: Children({ a: "Systolic" }) is Code, Children({ a: "BP" }) is Concept, and mismatched as Code/as Concept needed runtime JSON shape checks.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic structural child clinical values did not have Code/Concept runtime JSON shape validation.
issues.resolution: Added clinical JSON type checks for structural child values while preserving path-aware FHIR resource property behavior.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py; DQM subset 12/12 perfect; full fhir4ds pytest 7148 passed

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Convert operator: supports conversion between compatible clinical type representations
issues.evidence: convert { "Systolic" } to Concept and convert "BP" to List<Code> lowered to missing ToConceptFromList/ConceptToListCode UDFs.
issues.root_cause: Translator support existed without matching DuckDB UDF registration.
issues.resolution: Implemented ToConceptFromList(VARCHAR[]) and ConceptToListCode(VARCHAR), registered them, and added native/fallback parity tests.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py; full fhir4ds pytest 7148 passed; conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: Workflow requirement: DuckDB-backed surfaces must test native/C++ and Python fallback paths where both exist
issues.evidence: _python_only_connection() loaded register_fhirpath(), so fhirpath_predicate was present and native FHIRPath was still active.
issues.root_cause: The forced fallback helper delegated to extension registration, which attempts native loading before Python UDF registration.
issues.resolution: Registered Python FHIRPath UDFs directly in the helper, skipped include_fhirpath in CQL supplements, and asserted fhirpath_predicate is absent.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py forced fallback assertions; full fhir4ds pytest 7148 passed

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath R4 type operators and FHIR choice element semantics; CQL Code/Concept equivalence over FHIR choice values
issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback returned false/null for Observation.valueInteger value.is/as(Integer), and O.value as Concept ~ Code failed on Python while native passed.
issues.root_cause: Python FHIRPath fallback only resolved simple choice navigation/ofType and the CQL equivalence lowering lost resource/path context after clinical as Concept.
issues.resolution: Added generated-metadata simple choice is/as fallback and emitted coding_matches(resource, valueCodeableConcept, ...) for CodeableConcept equivalence while preserving in_valueset(resource, value, ...) behavior.
issues.verified_in: test_structural_type_parity.py; test_clinical_type_parity.py; DQM subset 12/12 perfect; full conformance 2822/2822
